lifecycle_process_node.label: Lifecycle Process Node

consumption_component_node.label: Consumption Component Node

contribution_card.label: Contribution Card

uses.label: uses

precedes.label: precedes

follows.label: follows

sits_below.label: sits below

supports.label: supports

challenges.label: challenges
challenges.description: A contribution or evidence item challenges a node or definition.

maps_to.label: maps to
maps_to.description: A node maps to another framework, taxonomy, control, or standard.

monitors.label: monitors
monitors.description: A control monitors a resource, process, agent, or outcome.

produces_evidence.label: produces evidence
produces_evidence.description: A process or control produces evidence for assurance.

definition.shortDefinition: Drafts user stories and acceptance criteria for a TM Forum use case, grounded in its own Description/Scope/Objective text.
definition.description: Given a TMFSxxx use-case id, reads its Description/Scope/Objective sections and drafts user stories and acceptance criteria, citing the exact component/API ids from its frontmatter for any integration touchpoint rather than inventing them. Turns an existing use case into requirements a delivery team can work from.

typeSpecific.processInput: A TMFSxxx use-case id.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Checks the use case's maturity, then reads its Description/Scope/Objective sections and linked component/API frontmatter to draft user stories and acceptance criteria grounded in that real content.
typeSpecific.processOutput: User stories and acceptance criteria for the use case, citing real component/API ids for every integration touchpoint.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Business analyst / product owner turning a use case into deliverable requirements.
typeSpecific.gates: Maturity check (check-usecase-maturity) before requirements are drafted.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Feeds draft-architecture-diagram-from-usecase and generate-test-cases-from-usecase.
typeSpecific.evidenceProduced: Draft user stories and acceptance criteria document.

definition.shortDefinition: Returns a plain-language maturity/trust verdict for an ODA use case before anyone builds against it.
definition.description: Given a TM Forum ODA use-case id (TMFSxxx), reads its cached frontmatter and returns a plain-language maturity/trust verdict -- whether it's safe to build against today. Reads only YAML frontmatter, no document-body parsing.

typeSpecific.processInput: A TMFSxxx use-case id.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Reads the use case's cached YAML frontmatter only and translates its maturity metadata into a plain-language build-against-today verdict.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A plain-language maturity/trust verdict for the use case.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Anyone about to start requirements or test-case work against a use case.
typeSpecific.gates: Run before starting requirements or test-case work against any TMFSxxx use case.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Gates capture-requirements-from-usecase, draft-architecture-diagram-from-usecase, and generate-test-cases-from-usecase.

definition.shortDefinition: Decomposes a plain-language requirement with no matching use case into a structured ODA-aligned breakdown.
definition.description: Given a plain-language requirement that recommend-oda-components-for-requirement couldn't match to an existing use case, produces a structured ODA-aligned decomposition -- business intent, candidate eTOM processes, candidate components/APIs, candidate information entities, and explicit open questions -- instead of leaving the requirement as unstructured prose. ODA-first, not ODA-only: extends only where the cached corpus genuinely has no equivalent.

typeSpecific.processInput: A plain-language requirement with no close-matching existing use case.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Decomposes the requirement into business intent, candidate eTOM processes, candidate components/APIs, and candidate information entities, cross-checked against the cached corpus and the gaps backlog at every step; flags genuine gaps explicitly rather than presenting an extension as already standard.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A structured ODA-aligned decomposition of the requirement with explicit open questions.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Solution architect scoping a requirement that has no existing ODA analog.
typeSpecific.gates: Only run after recommend-oda-components-for-requirement has confirmed no close match exists.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Feeds propose-component-or-api-extension where a genuine gap is confirmed, or draft-new-usecase-from-scenario where the decomposition warrants a new use case.

nodes.label: Draft Architecture Diagram from Use Case

definition.shortDefinition: Emits a Mermaid sequence or architecture diagram for a use case, drawn only from its real sequence-diagram content and component/API links.
definition.description: Given a TMFSxxx use-case id, reads its sequence-diagram images and linked component/API frontmatter, and emits a Mermaid sequence or architecture diagram as a design-doc-ready artifact, citing only real component/API ids.

typeSpecific.processInput: A TMFSxxx use-case id.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Checks maturity, then redraws a Mermaid sequenceDiagram or component-relationship graph from the use case's own sequence-diagram content and frontmatter links.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A design-doc-ready Mermaid diagram citing only real component/API ids.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Solution architect documenting a use case's flow or component interactions.
typeSpecific.gates: Maturity check before diagramming.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Feeds draft-event-design-for-component and validate-design-against-oda when the diagram informs a new design.

definition.shortDefinition: Renders an ODA Component's architecture as a standalone SVG with D3, straight from its cached component.yaml or a component Helm chart.
definition.description: Given a TMFCxxx id (or all), or a component Helm chart compiled with helm template, renders a deterministic SVG architecture diagram in the style of the ODA Component Specification PDFs: the component box with its eTOM business activities and SID data entities, dependent APIs as sockets on the left and exposed APIs as lollipops on the right, colour-coded by core/management/security function. For a chart, the box shows the chart's microservices and how each is wired to its APIs, derived from Service selectors and env vars. Shipped in both the consumer and creator plugins.

typeSpecific.processInput: A TMFCxxx component id (or 'all'), or a directory containing a component Helm chart.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Runs bundled Node scripts that model the component.yaml (or the kind: Component document from helm template) and draw it with D3, then verifies the SVG against the source and, for charts, independently audits every drawn link against the raw helm output.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A standalone SVG architecture diagram per component, plus a verification report (and optional HTML gallery).
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Solution architect or developer documenting a component they build against or implement; contributor illustrating a component they propose or extend.
typeSpecific.gates: Verification pass (SVG counts and API ids against the YAML); for charts, an independent link audit whose warnings must be reported, not hidden.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Illustrates designs for validate-design-against-oda and review-architecture-against-oda; renders charts produced by implement-oda-component; illustrates proposals from propose-component-or-api-extension.
typeSpecific.evidenceProduced: SVG diagram artifacts and verify/audit output.

definition.shortDefinition: Drafts published/subscribed event definitions for a component, in the same shape every cached component.yaml's eventNotification block already uses.
definition.description: Given a TMFCxxx component id and the APIs it exposes or depends on, drafts published/subscribed event definitions -- resource-level create/attributeValueChange/stateChange/delete events tied to real resource names, never invented event types. A Design-stage skill: drafts an addition consistent with how every other cached component already expresses events.

typeSpecific.processInput: A TMFCxxx component id and the APIs it exposes or depends on.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Checks whether the needed event is already covered by an existing eventNotification entry on the component or the component that owns the dependent API; drafts only what's genuinely missing, in the same shape as existing eventNotification blocks.
typeSpecific.processOutput: Drafted published/subscribed event definitions for the component.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Component designer extending a component's event model.
typeSpecific.gates: Confirm the event isn't already covered before drafting a new one.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Feeds generate-implementation-scaffold-from-usecase or implement-oda-component when the design is built.
typeSpecific.evidenceProduced: Draft event definition(s) in eventNotification shape.

definition.shortDefinition: Proposes a starting architecture of real ODA components/APIs for a plain-language requirement with no TMFSxxx id yet.
definition.description: Given a plain-language business requirement (not yet a TMFSxxx id), finds the closest-matching existing use case(s) by name and component/API overlap, and proposes a starting architecture grounded in real component/API ids -- never invented ones. The greenfield counterpart to validate-design-against-oda.

typeSpecific.processInput: A plain-language business requirement.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Finds the closest-matching existing use case(s) by name and component/API overlap and proposes a starting architecture from real ids.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A proposed starting architecture (component/API list) grounded in real ids, or a clear statement that nothing matches closely.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Solution architect at the start of a design, before a requirement is mapped to a specific use case.
typeSpecific.gates: Run at the start of a design, before requirements capture.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Feeds capture-requirements-from-usecase when a match is found, or decompose-requirement-against-oda when nothing matches closely.
typeSpecific.evidenceProduced: Candidate architecture proposal with cited component/API ids.

definition.shortDefinition: Reviews a whole multi-component architecture for ODA conformance -- duplicated ownership, point-to-point coupling, and component-boundary bypass.
definition.description: Given a description of a proposed or existing multi-component architecture, reviews it against the cached ODA corpus for duplicated ownership (a capability assigned to a new/custom component that an existing TMFCxxx already owns), point-to-point coupling (a direct interaction an existing cached Open API already mediates), and component-boundary bypass (an interaction reaching into another component's internals). The only skill that reasons about a whole architecture's ODA conformance at once.

typeSpecific.processInput: A description of a proposed or existing multi-component architecture.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Parses the architecture into components and interactions and checks each against the cached ODA corpus for duplicated ownership, point-to-point coupling, and component-boundary bypass, cross-checking the gaps backlog before flagging a genuine gap as a violation.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A whole-architecture ODA conformance review with findings on ownership duplication, coupling, and boundary bypass.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Enterprise/solution architect reviewing a multi-component design.
typeSpecific.gates: Design-stage architecture review gate before build.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Findings feed back into recommend-oda-components-for-requirement / decompose-requirement-against-oda, or into propose-component-or-api-extension for genuine gaps.

definition.shortDefinition: Checks a proposed design's claimed dependencies on existing ODA components/APIs against the real cached specs.
definition.description: Given a proposed component or API design that claims to extend or depend on existing ODA components/APIs, checks those claims against the real cached specs and flags drift -- fields, operations, or behavior the design assumes exist but don't. A pre-build check, sitting earlier than audit-implementation-against-usecase or propose-component-or-api-extension.

typeSpecific.processInput: A proposed component or API design with claimed dependencies on existing ODA components/APIs.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Checks each claimed dependency against the real cached component/API specs and flags any field, operation, or behavior the design assumes exists but doesn't.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A drift report confirming or refuting the design's assumptions about existing ODA capability.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Designer confirming assumptions before building or extending against them.
typeSpecific.gates: Run before building against an assumed ODA capability.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Clears the design for generate-implementation-scaffold-from-usecase or implement-oda-component; flags feed propose-component-or-api-extension.

nodes.label: Draft New Use Case from Scenario

definition.shortDefinition: Drafts a new TMFSxxx-shaped use-case document from a business scenario that matches no existing use case or known gap.
definition.description: Given a business scenario description, drafts a new TMFSxxx-shaped use-case document matching this corpus's own observed structure, citing real existing component/API ids wherever the scenario matches existing ODA capability and flagging genuine gaps rather than inventing plausible-sounding new ids.

typeSpecific.processInput: A business scenario description that recommend-oda-components-for-requirement and the gaps backlog don't already cover.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Drafts a new use-case document in the corpus's own observed TMFSxxx structure, citing real component/API ids where the scenario matches existing capability and flagging genuine gaps explicitly.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A draft TMFSxxx-shaped use-case document.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: TM Forum contributor authoring a new use case.
typeSpecific.gates: Only drafted after recommend-oda-components-for-requirement reports no close match and the gaps backlog also has no matching entry.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Feeds lint-usecase-draft for pre-submission QA before the document is submitted.

definition.shortDefinition: Mines every use case's Lessons Learned/Impacts Identified sections for capability gaps, cross-checked against the current index and consolidated into a backlog.
definition.description: Mines every TMFSxxx use case's 'Lessons learned'/'Impacts identified' sections for capability gaps TM Forum's own authors have already written down -- proposed new ODA components or Open APIs that don't exist yet -- cross-checks each against the current components/apis index to confirm it's still genuinely missing, and consolidates cross-corroborated gaps into one backlog entry.

typeSpecific.processInput: The full corpus of converted TMFSxxx use-case documents.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Reads the Lessons Learned / Impacts Identified section of every use case, extracts proposed-but-missing components/APIs, cross-checks each against the current components/apis index, and consolidates gaps raised independently in multiple use cases into one backlog entry.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A consolidated capability-gaps backlog.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: TM Forum contributor deciding what ODA should build next.
typeSpecific.gates: None -- a periodic mining pass, not a build gate.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Feeds propose-component-or-api-extension for each confirmed gap.

definition.shortDefinition: Turns logged use-case/matrix disagreements into specific, submittable correction proposals for the next standard revision.
definition.description: Turns matrix-discrepancies.md's logged use-case/matrix disagreements into specific, submittable correction proposals for the next IG1228 revision -- e.g. which TMFCxxx rows should be added or removed for a given TMFSxxx use case.

typeSpecific.processInput: A logged disagreement from matrix-discrepancies.md between a use case's own document and the usecase-component matrix.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Reads the disagreement and the use case's own document, then drafts a specific, submittable correction (e.g. which component rows to add or remove) for the next IG1228 revision.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A specific, submittable matrix correction proposal.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: TM Forum contributor preparing standard-revision input.
typeSpecific.gates: None -- acts on an already-logged discrepancy.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Submitted to the TM Forum IG1228 revision process.

definition.shortDefinition: Pre-submission QA pass that flags anything in a draft use-case document likely to silently lose content when converted.
definition.description: Checks a draft TM Forum use-case DOCX or Markdown document's structure against document shapes known to convert badly through this repo's own docx2md.py pipeline, and flags anything likely to silently lose content before the document is ever submitted.

typeSpecific.processInput: A draft use-case document (DOCX or Markdown).
typeSpecific.processActivity: Checks the draft's structure against known-bad conversion shapes for the corpus's docx2md.py pipeline and flags anything likely to silently lose content on conversion.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A pre-submission QA report of structural issues to fix before conversion.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Use-case author performing a pre-submission QA pass.
typeSpecific.gates: Pre-submission QA gate for a new or revised use case.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Clears the draft for submission once issues are fixed; feeds back into draft-new-usecase-from-scenario for rework.
typeSpecific.evidenceProduced: QA findings report on the draft document.

definition.shortDefinition: Drafts a concrete extension -- a new component skeleton or an API schema addition -- for an already-identified capability gap.
definition.description: Given a capability gap (e.g. from gaps-backlog.md) and the nearest existing component/API, drafts a proposed extension -- a new component skeleton in IG1242's real shape, or a new field/endpoint on an existing OpenAPI schema -- consistent with the corpus's own conventions and grounded in a real cached spec.

typeSpecific.processInput: A capability gap (typically from gaps-backlog.md) and the nearest existing component/API.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Drafts a concrete extension -- a new component skeleton in IG1242 shape, or a new field/endpoint on an existing OpenAPI schema -- consistent with the corpus's own conventions.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A draft component skeleton or API schema extension addressing the gap.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: TM Forum contributor designing a fix for an identified gap.
typeSpecific.gates: Run only after a gap has been identified (typically via feedback-harvest-gaps-from-lessons-learned or decompose-requirement-against-oda).
typeSpecific.handoffs: Submitted as a proposed extension to the ODA standard; may inform implement-oda-component once accepted.
typeSpecific.evidenceProduced: Draft component skeleton or API schema extension.

definition.shortDefinition: Checks an existing implementation's conformance to a component's full contract, scored separately for Core Function and Supporting Function.
definition.description: Given a TMFCxxx component id and a description of an existing implementation, checks conformance at Component-boundary granularity, split the way component.yaml itself is split -- Core Function (does it expose/consume the real exposedAPIs/dependentAPIs) and Supporting Function (does it provide the managementFunction/securityFunction behaviors) -- reported as two separate dimensions, never blended into one score.

typeSpecific.processInput: A TMFCxxx component id and a description of an existing implementation.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Establishes the real contract from the component's cached spec, then checks the implementation's Core Function (exposed/dependent APIs) and Supporting Function (management/security behaviors) separately, never blending the two into one score.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A two-dimensional conformance report: Core Function score and Supporting Function score.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Implementation owner auditing a built component's full contract, independent of any specific use case.
typeSpecific.gates: Run to audit conformance independent of any single use case's flow.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Findings feed a remediation backlog or assess-change-impact if drift implies a breaking gap.

definition.shortDefinition: Checks whether an existing implementation actually follows a use case's described flow and calls the right real APIs.
definition.description: Given a TMFSxxx use-case id and an existing implementation (codebase, API contract, or integration config), checks whether the implementation actually follows the use case's described flow and calls the right real APIs, flagging drift from spec. The reverse of validate-design-against-oda, which checks a proposed design before it's built.

typeSpecific.processInput: A TMFSxxx use-case id and a description of an existing implementation.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Checks maturity, then compares the existing implementation's flow and API calls against the use case's described flow, flagging any drift from spec.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A drift report on flow and API-call fidelity to the use case.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Implementation owner auditing an existing system against ODA.
typeSpecific.gates: Maturity check first.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Findings feed a remediation plan or assess-change-impact if drift reveals a dependency risk.

definition.shortDefinition: Generates conformance test assertions for one TM Forum Open API directly from its cached OpenAPI schema, and scores an implementation against them if one is supplied.
definition.description: Given a TMFxxx id and version, generates conformance test assertions directly from its cached OpenAPI schema -- required-field presence, enum-value validity, declared operations per path, and expected status codes -- using real sample payloads as fixtures where they exist. If a real implementation is supplied, also reports pass/fail per assertion; without one, produces a standalone suite ready to run once an implementation exists.

typeSpecific.processInput: A TMFxxx API id and version, optionally a real implementation (base URL or example request/response pairs).
typeSpecific.processActivity: Resolves the API's real cached schema and generates conformance assertions from it (required fields, enum validity, declared operations, expected status codes); scores a supplied implementation pass/fail per assertion, or produces a standalone suite otherwise.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A conformance test suite for the API, optionally with pass/fail results against a supplied implementation.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: API implementer verifying schema conformance for one specific TM Forum Open API.
typeSpecific.gates: Requires a real fetched schema version -- stops if the API's status shows no real schema exists yet.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Complements generate-test-cases-from-usecase (use-case-flow level) and feeds audit-implementation-against-component.
typeSpecific.evidenceProduced: Generated conformance test suite and, where an implementation is supplied, pass/fail results.

nodes.label: Generate API Mocks from Use Case

definition.shortDefinition: Scaffolds a mock server or fixture files for a use case's real dependent APIs, for integration testing before a real backend exists.
definition.description: Given a TMFSxxx use-case id, uses its linked APIs' cached OpenAPI schemas and real sample payloads to scaffold a mock server or example request/response fixtures for integration testing before a real backend exists.

typeSpecific.processInput: A TMFSxxx use-case id.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Resolves the use case's real API list, then scaffolds a mock server or fixture files from those APIs' cached OpenAPI schemas and real sample payloads.
typeSpecific.processOutput: Mock server and/or fixture files for the use case's dependent APIs.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Developer needing integration test fixtures before a real backend exists.
typeSpecific.gates: None beyond resolving the use case's real API list.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Used alongside generate-test-cases-from-usecase and generate-implementation-scaffold-from-usecase during build.

nodes.label: Generate Implementation Scaffold from Use Case

definition.shortDefinition: Generates typed request/response models and route/handler stubs from a use case's linked OpenAPI schemas, in the caller's chosen language, with TODOs where real logic belongs.
definition.description: Given a TMFSxxx use-case id (or an explicit component/API set), generates typed request/response models and route/handler stubs directly from its linked APIs' cached OpenAPI schemas, in a language of the caller's choosing -- with a TODO marker at every point real domain logic belongs. A Build-stage skill, narrow by design: it scaffolds shape, not business logic. Not to be confused with implement-oda-component, which generates and can deploy TM Forum's own opinionated Node.js/Helm reference stack.

typeSpecific.processInput: A TMFSxxx use-case id (or explicit component/API set) and a target language.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Resolves the target APIs and language, then generates typed request/response models and route/handler stubs from the cached OpenAPI schemas, marking every point real domain logic belongs with a TODO.
typeSpecific.processOutput: Typed models and route/handler scaffolding in the target language, with TODO markers for business logic.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Developer starting implementation from typed models rather than a blank file.
typeSpecific.gates: Ask which of this skill or implement-oda-component is wanted if not obvious from context -- never default silently.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Hands a codebase skeleton to the developer who fills in domain logic; complements generate-api-mocks-from-usecase.

nodes.label: Generate Test Cases from Use Case

definition.shortDefinition: Drafts BDD-style Gherkin test scenarios for a use case's interaction flow, grounded in its real component/API ids and cached OpenAPI schemas.
definition.description: Given a TM Forum ODA use-case id (TMFSxxx), reads its sequence-diagram section and linked component/API frontmatter, then drafts BDD-style (Gherkin) test scenarios grounded in the real component/API ids and cached OpenAPI schemas -- never invented ones. Mirrors oda-canvas's write-bdd-feature Gherkin conventions.

typeSpecific.processInput: A TMFSxxx use-case id.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Reads the use case's sequence-diagram section and linked component/API frontmatter, then drafts Gherkin scenarios citing only real, traceable component/API ids.
typeSpecific.processOutput: BDD-style Gherkin test scenarios for the use case's interaction flow.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: QA engineer / developer drafting acceptance tests for a use case.
typeSpecific.gates: None beyond the ids in the scenario tracing back to real frontmatter or a cached API schema.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Feeds generate-api-mocks-from-usecase and generate-api-conformance-tests during build; later checked by audit-implementation-against-usecase.

definition.shortDefinition: Orchestrates the full Discover-to-Run chain of existing skills against a plain-language requirement, end to end.
definition.description: Given a plain-language requirement, orchestrates the full Discover-to-Run chain of existing skills against it -- finding or decomposing the requirement, capturing it as requirements, drafting architecture/event designs, gating on validate-design-against-oda, generating a Build-stage implementation, generating mocks/tests/conformance checks, and auditing the result. An orchestration skill with no ODA reasoning of its own -- every real decision is made by the skill it invokes at that step.

typeSpecific.processInput: A plain-language requirement.
typeSpecific.processActivity: Sequences the existing chain of skills: find/decompose the requirement, capture requirements, draft architecture/event designs, gate on validate-design-against-oda, generate a Build-stage implementation (asking which of the two build options to use), generate mocks/tests/conformance checks, and audit the result.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A working, audited implementation delivered end to end from a plain-language requirement.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Delivery lead wanting a requirement taken all the way from ask to audited implementation in one pass.
typeSpecific.gates: Gates on validate-design-against-oda before generating a Build-stage implementation; asks which build option to use rather than defaulting.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Invokes recommend-oda-components-for-requirement/decompose-requirement-against-oda, capture-requirements-from-usecase, draft-architecture-diagram-from-usecase, draft-event-design-for-component, validate-design-against-oda, generate-implementation-scaffold-from-usecase/implement-oda-component, generate-api-mocks-from-usecase, generate-test-cases-from-usecase, generate-api-conformance-tests, and audit-implementation-against-usecase, in sequence.
typeSpecific.evidenceProduced: End-to-end delivery trail: requirements, designs, generated implementation, tests, and audit report.

definition.shortDefinition: Assesses the blast radius of a proposed breaking change to an ODA component or API before it ships.
definition.description: Given a TM Forum ODA component (TMFCxxx) or Open API (TMFxxx) id and a proposed change (deprecation, breaking version bump, removal), lists every use case that depends on it, describes exactly how each one uses it, and drafts a maturity-weighted migration/impact report. Used as a release-risk gate before a breaking change, deprecation, or removal goes out.

typeSpecific.processInput: A TMFCxxx component id or TMFxxx API id, plus the proposed change (deprecation, breaking version bump, or removal).
typeSpecific.processActivity: Looks up every TMFSxxx use case that depends on the target id, describes precisely how each dependency is used, weights each by the use case's maturity, and drafts a migration/impact report.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A maturity-weighted migration/impact report listing every affected use case and the specific nature of its dependency.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Component/API owner deciding whether to ship a breaking change; downstream teams whose use cases depend on the id.
typeSpecific.gates: Should be run and reviewed before any deprecation, breaking version bump, or removal is released.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Feeds the release decision for the component/API owner; may trigger propose-component-or-api-extension or a coordinated migration plan for affected teams.
typeSpecific.evidenceProduced: Impact/migration report enumerating affected use cases and their maturity-weighted risk.

definition.shortDefinition: Builds and deploys a complete TM Forum ODA Component implementation (Node.js source, Dockerfile, Helm chart) end to end.
definition.description: Builds a complete TM Forum ODA Component implementation from scratch -- Node.js microservice source code, Dockerfiles, and Kubernetes Helm charts -- for any standard component (TMFC001-TMFC062). The one skill in this corpus with real side effects: it can build and push Docker images and run `helm install`. Distinct from generate-implementation-scaffold-from-usecase, which produces a language-agnostic, no-side-effect scaffold instead of TM Forum's own opinionated Node.js/Helm reference stack.

typeSpecific.processInput: A TMFCxxx component id (or a plain-language component name to resolve to one).
typeSpecific.processActivity: Generates Node.js microservice source code, Dockerfiles, and Kubernetes Helm charts following the ODA Component standard; builds and pushes the Docker image; can run `helm install` to activate the component in a cluster.
typeSpecific.processOutput: A running (or ready-to-run) ODA Component: source repository, container image in a registry, and an installed/installable Helm release.
typeSpecific.rolesInvolved: Component implementer/platform engineer standing up a standard ODA component.
typeSpecific.gates: Real side effects (image push, helm install) -- should only be run once the target component and environment are confirmed.
typeSpecific.handoffs: Produces the artifact that audit-implementation-against-component later checks for conformance; supersedes a bare scaffold from generate-implementation-scaffold-from-usecase when the reference Node.js/Helm stack is wanted.
typeSpecific.evidenceProduced: Built container image, Helm release, and generated source repository for the component.

definition.shortDefinition: A human or team building software against the existing ODA standard, using the consumer skill set to discover, design, build, test, and audit against real ODA components, APIs, and use cases.
definition.description: Represents the 'build against ODA' role served by the tm-forum-oda-consumer plugin: solution architects, developers, and QA engineers who look up, design against, implement, test, and audit implementations of TM Forum ODA use cases, components, and Open APIs -- never a corpus contributor extending ODA itself.

typeSpecific.functionCapability: Discovers, designs against, builds, tests, and audits implementations using the ODA knowledge base and consumer skill set.
typeSpecific.interactionPattern: Invokes consumer skills (e.g. recommend-oda-components-for-requirement, capture-requirements-from-usecase, generate-implementation-scaffold-from-usecase, implement-oda-component, generate-test-cases-from-usecase, generate-component-svg-diagram, audit-implementation-against-usecase) via an AI coding agent.
typeSpecific.capabilityDescription: Builds a product or system against the existing ODA reference architecture, from requirement discovery through to an audited implementation, without modifying the ODA corpus itself.
typeSpecific.riskBoundary: Cannot alter accepted ODA nodes or the knowledge corpus; consumer skills only read the cached knowledge base and, in the case of implement-oda-component, may build/push images and deploy via Helm into the caller's own environment.
typeSpecific.expectedUsers: Solution architects, developers, QA engineers, and delivery leads building against TM Forum ODA.

definition.shortDefinition: A human or team extending and improving the ODA standard itself, using the creator skill set to author use cases, harvest gaps, and propose corrections and extensions.
definition.description: Represents the 'extend and contribute to ODA' role served by the tm-forum-oda-creator plugin: TM Forum members and practitioners who draft new use cases, mine lessons-learned sections for capability gaps, propose matrix corrections, lint draft documents, and design component/API extensions -- feeding the central authority's review process rather than building against an already-accepted standard.

typeSpecific.functionCapability: Authors new use cases, harvests capability gaps from the existing corpus, proposes matrix corrections, and drafts component/API extensions for the central authority to review.
typeSpecific.interactionPattern: Invokes creator skills (e.g. draft-new-usecase-from-scenario, feedback-harvest-gaps-from-lessons-learned, feedback-propose-matrix-correction, lint-usecase-draft, propose-component-or-api-extension, generate-component-svg-diagram) via an AI coding agent, producing proposed contributions for TM Forum review.
typeSpecific.capabilityDescription: Extends and improves the ODA reference architecture itself -- new use cases, gap backlogs, matrix corrections, and component/API extension proposals -- submitted as proposed contributions for the central authority to accept.
typeSpecific.riskBoundary: Can only create status='proposed' contributions; accepted nodes can only be set by the central authority (TM Forum Trustworthy AI & Data Mission), never mutated directly by a contributor.
typeSpecific.expectedUsers: TM Forum member organizations, ODA standard editors, and practitioners contributing use cases or corrections.

definition.shortDefinition: The cached TM Forum ODA corpus (use cases, components, Open APIs, eTOM, SID, and cross-reference indexes) packaged as a provenance-tracked, queryable knowledge base for agent skills.
definition.description: The knowledge/ directory bundled with each plugin: use-cases.json, components.json, apis.json, an ID-registry cross-reference layer (usecase-component-matrix.json, gaps-backlog.md, matrix-discrepancies.md, component-pdf-coverage.md, id-registry.md), and a derived OWL/RDF export (ontology.ttl). Generated and refreshed from upstream TM Forum sources (IG1228, component/API specs) via idempotent build scripts, and consumed by every skill as its single source of truth rather than requiring the agent to scan raw documents directly.

typeSpecific.functionPerformed: Provides a structured, provenance-tracked, queryable representation of the TM Forum ODA standard (use cases, components, Open APIs, eTOM, SID) that every skill reads instead of parsing raw source documents.
typeSpecific.interfacePattern: Indexed JSON/Markdown files under knowledge/index/ plus per-artefact folders under knowledge/{use-cases,components,apis,etom,sid}/, read directly by skills via file paths; a derived ontology.ttl RDF/OWL export is available for external graph tooling.
typeSpecific.componentFunction: Acts as the queryable data layer underpinning every skill's answers, keeping generated indexes (use-cases.json, components.json, apis.json, ontology.ttl) in sync with static/hand-maintained cross-reference files (gaps-backlog.md, matrix-discrepancies.md, id-registry.md).
typeSpecific.supplierExamples: Generated internally via tools/build_index.py and tools/build_ontology.py from upstream TM Forum IG1228/component/API sources; comparable in kind to a data-product / data-mesh pattern implemented with a metadata catalog such as DataHub or Collibra.
typeSpecific.interoperability: OWL/RDF (Turtle) export for external graph/ontology tooling (e.g. Protege); JSON indexes for direct skill consumption.

definition.shortDefinition: An AI Agent plugin marketplace distributing two ODA skill bundles -- consumer (build against ODA) and creator (extend ODA) -- each a catalog of Agent Skills backed by the ODA knowledge base.
definition.description: The .claude-plugin/marketplace.json manifest and its two plugins (tm-forum-oda-consumer, tm-forum-oda-creator), each with its own .claude-plugin/plugin.json and skills/ directory of Agent Skill definitions (SKILL.md). Installed into an AI coding agent (e.g. via a plugin marketplace mechanism) to give it every Design/Develop/Deploy lifecycle skill in this corpus, backed by the ODA-as-a-Data-Product knowledge base.

typeSpecific.functionPerformed: Packages and distributes the full set of ODA lifecycle Agent Skills as installable plugins, so an AI agent can discover and invoke them by name.
typeSpecific.interfacePattern: AI agent plugin marketplace protocol (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json listing plugins; each plugin's .claude-plugin/plugin.json plus a skills/ directory of SKILL.md-defined Agent Skills, invoked by an agent via natural-language trigger matching on each skill's description).
typeSpecific.componentFunction: Central catalog and install mechanism for every skill node under Design, Develop, and Deploy in this ontology.
typeSpecific.supplierExamples: e.g. AI agent plugin marketplaces generally (this instance uses the Claude Code plugin marketplace format); comparable in kind to any agent tool/skill registry or catalog (e.g. an MCP server registry).
typeSpecific.interoperability: AI agent plugin marketplace format (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json); Agent Skills format (SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter).

evidenceItems.title: Capture Requirements from Use Case -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Drafts user stories and acceptance criteria for a TM Forum use case, grounded in its own Description/Scope/Objective text.

evidenceItems.title: Check Use Case Maturity -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Returns a plain-language maturity/trust verdict for an ODA use case before anyone builds against it.

evidenceItems.title: Decompose Requirement Against ODA -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Decomposes a plain-language requirement with no matching use case into a structured ODA-aligned breakdown.

evidenceItems.title: Draft Architecture Diagram from Use Case -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Emits a Mermaid sequence or architecture diagram for a use case, drawn only from its real sequence-diagram content and component/API links.

evidenceItems.title: Generate Component SVG Diagram -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Renders an ODA Component's architecture as a standalone SVG with D3, straight from its cached component.yaml or a component Helm chart.

evidenceItems.title: Draft Event Design for Component -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Drafts published/subscribed event definitions for a component, in the same shape every cached component.yaml's eventNotification block already uses.

evidenceItems.title: Recommend ODA Components for Requirement -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Proposes a starting architecture of real ODA components/APIs for a plain-language requirement with no TMFSxxx id yet.

evidenceItems.title: Review Architecture Against ODA -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Reviews a whole multi-component architecture for ODA conformance -- duplicated ownership, point-to-point coupling, and component-boundary bypass.

evidenceItems.title: Validate Design Against ODA -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Checks a proposed design's claimed dependencies on existing ODA components/APIs against the real cached specs.

evidenceItems.title: Draft New Use Case from Scenario -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Drafts a new TMFSxxx-shaped use-case document from a business scenario that matches no existing use case or known gap.

evidenceItems.title: Harvest Gaps from Lessons Learned -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Mines every use case's Lessons Learned/Impacts Identified sections for capability gaps, cross-checked against the current index and consolidated into a backlog.

evidenceItems.title: Propose Matrix Correction -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Turns logged use-case/matrix disagreements into specific, submittable correction proposals for the next standard revision.

evidenceItems.title: Lint Use Case Draft -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Pre-submission QA pass that flags anything in a draft use-case document likely to silently lose content when converted.

evidenceItems.title: Propose Component or API Extension -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Drafts a concrete extension -- a new component skeleton or an API schema addition -- for an already-identified capability gap.

evidenceItems.title: Audit Implementation Against Component -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Checks an existing implementation's conformance to a component's full contract, scored separately for Core Function and Supporting Function.

evidenceItems.title: Audit Implementation Against Use Case -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Checks whether an existing implementation actually follows a use case's described flow and calls the right real APIs.

evidenceItems.title: Generate API Conformance Tests -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Generates conformance test assertions for one TM Forum Open API directly from its cached OpenAPI schema, and scores an implementation against them if one is supplied.

evidenceItems.title: Generate API Mocks from Use Case -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Scaffolds a mock server or fixture files for a use case's real dependent APIs, for integration testing before a real backend exists.

evidenceItems.title: Generate Implementation Scaffold from Use Case -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Generates typed request/response models and route/handler stubs from a use case's linked OpenAPI schemas, in the caller's chosen language, with TODOs where real logic belongs.

evidenceItems.title: Generate Test Cases from Use Case -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Drafts BDD-style Gherkin test scenarios for a use case's interaction flow, grounded in its real component/API ids and cached OpenAPI schemas.

evidenceItems.title: Deliver ODA Requirement -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Orchestrates the full Discover-to-Run chain of existing skills against a plain-language requirement, end to end.

evidenceItems.title: Assess Change Impact -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Assesses the blast radius of a proposed breaking change to an ODA component or API before it ships.

evidenceItems.title: Implement ODA Component -- SKILL.md
evidenceItems.abstract: Builds and deploys a complete TM Forum ODA Component implementation (Node.js source, Dockerfile, Helm chart) end to end.

evidenceItems.title: tm-forum-oda-consumer plugin manifest
evidenceItems.abstract: TM Forum ODA use cases, components, and Open APIs as a provenance-tracked knowledge base, queryable via Agent Skills -- for building a product against ODA.

evidenceItems.title: tm-forum-oda-creator plugin manifest
evidenceItems.abstract: Agent Skills backed by TM Forum ODA knowledge -- for extending and contributing to ODA itself.

evidenceItems.title: knowledge/index/ README -- ID registry and cross-reference layer
evidenceItems.abstract: Describes the ID registry and cross-reference layer (use-cases.json, components.json, apis.json, matrix-discrepancies.md, gaps-backlog.md, ontology.ttl) that every skill in the corpus reads instead of scanning raw documents.

evidenceItems.title: tm-forum-oda-marketplace -- AI agent plugin marketplace manifest
evidenceItems.abstract: Lists the two installable plugins (tm-forum-oda-consumer, tm-forum-oda-creator) that bundle every Design/Develop/Deploy skill in this corpus as AI Agent Skills.
